Geometry

The Geometry module provides basic geometric structures and utilities used throughout PolynomialCovers.

These tools operate in the complex plane and support the construction of polygonal paths used by the lifting algorithms implemented in the package.

The module introduces three fundamental objects:

  • Disk — closed disks in the complex plane
  • Vertex — points in the complex plane
  • Path — discrete polygonal paths built from vertices

These objects are used to construct safe paths that avoid critical value regions when performing numerical path lifting.

Disks

A Disk represents a closed disk in the complex plane.

Mathematically it corresponds to

\[\mathbb{D} = \{ z ∈ ℂ : |z - c| ≤ r \}\]

where c is the center and r ≥ 0 the radius.

Polygonal Paths

A Path represents a discrete polygonal curve in the complex plane.

It is defined by a sequence of vertices

v₁ → v₂ → ... → vₙ

Safe Path Construction

The module provides algorithms to construct paths that avoid forbidden regions in the complex plane.

These routines are crucial for robust numerical lifting.

PolynomialCovers.safe_path_arc — Function
safe_path_arc(u, v, ρ; npoints=6)

Construct a polygonal path from u to v that avoids the disk of radius ρ centered at the origin.

If the straight segment does not intersect the disk, the path is the segment [u, v]. Otherwise, the path detours along a circular arc of radius slightly larger than ρ.

Returns a Path.

source

Missing docstring.

Missing docstring for avoid_points_path. Check Documenter's build log for details.

•	safe_path_arc constructs a path between two points that detours

around a forbidden disk if necessary. • approachpath constructs a path approaching the boundary of a disk from the inside. • avoidpoints_path constructs a path avoiding a finite set of forbidden points.

Internally, the avoidance algorithm uses a potential-field strategy combining attraction toward the target and repulsion from forbidden points.

Example

The following example constructs a polygonal path.

using PolynomialCovers

v1 = Vertex(0.0)
v2 = Vertex(1.0)
p = Path([v1,v2])
println(p)
Path(0.0 + 0.0im → 1.0 + 0.0im)

Role in PolynomialCovers

The geometry module plays a central role in the implementation of the lifting algorithms used by the package.

In particular, the path construction routines are used to build numerically safe paths in the complex plane that avoid the critical value disks of polynomial maps.
